learning_outcomes.text: Know the basics of legal data processing and computer security and their implications in connected industrial environments.
Know the principles of PLM and Lean Thinking in connected environments, as well as those of MVP development.
Know the basics of Agile methodologies and their field of application in industry.
Knowledge about data protection and computer security and their implications in the field of industrial engineering.
Basic knowledge about PLM and Lean Thinking in connected industrial environments.
Basic knowledge of Agile methodologies and their applications in the field of industrial engineering.

syllabus_topics: Main applications and examples of IC4.0
teaching_methods: Classroom presentation of concepts related to the subjects and problem-solving sessions
assessment_rules: Continuous assessment will consist of two exams: Exam 1 (50%) and Exam 2 (50%). Students who do not pass through continuous assessment will take an exam covering the entire course in the ORDINARY and/or EXTRAORDINARY retake sessions.
